text:
alisa: Heads-up — we've got a persistent 5xx spike on model-x-prod for /v2/infer requests started ~10m ago. Error rate ~12% on p95. I want to do an emergency prefix gatekeeper override to route new sessions to model-x-legacy while we investigate. Propose a 30m diversion window and passive logging.

nate: +1 for diversion. Quick checklist: 1) enable gatekeeper rule that matches prefix and rewrites X-Target-Model header to 'model-x-legacy' 2) ensure KV cache is bypassed for those sessions 3) create a temporary telemetry tag so we can filter metrics.

maria: Console note — the rollout UI is returning a 502 when targeting the eu-* clusters. We should run the change via gateway CLI for now, then try console after.

alisa: Agreed. I'll run the CLI. Command I'm about to use (sanity-checked):

```
redwood-gateway apply-rule --scope=prod --match=prefix:/v2/infer/model-x --action=override-header:X-Target-Model=model-x-legacy --action=bypass-kv=true --metadata=emergency_divert:2012345678
```

Expecting instant routing change for new sessions only. Old sessions should continue on existing backends.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout: rule=prefix-override:model-x user=alisa scope=prod

oncall: FYI — I'll watch SLOs and page if latency or error budget burns. Which dashboard should I look at?

nate: Use infra -> ingress -> model-routing ; filter by metadata=emergency_divert:2012345678. Also watch gateway-proxy latency and model-x-legacy token usage.

alisa: Rule applied. CLI output: rule-id=gatekeeper-2012345678 status=active. Pinging healthcheck now.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete: rule=gatekeeper-2012345678 status=active

maria: Seeing expected drop in model-x-prod error rate on the routed subset. Telemetry tag working. Nice.

oncall: p95 latency for legacy is +40ms but within SLO. No pages.

nate: Two operational notes: 1) we should avoid doing any A/B weight surgery during the diversion window 2) schedule an immediate postmortem ticket and set an auto-rollback timer at +30m if not explicitly extended.

alisa: Added postmortem ticket INF-2043 and set auto-rollback timer at 30m. Command used: `redwood-gateway schedule-rollback --rule gatekeeper-2012345678 --after=30m`

maria: Also opened a model onboarding bug for model-x flavor detection — might be related to tokenization mismatch leading to OOMs.

oncall: Telemetry shows a spike in cache-miss ratio before divert — consistent with KV desync. Good catch on bypass.

nate: Quick test for rollback if needed: `redwood-gateway rollback-rule gatekeeper-2012345678` — that flips routing back immediately, old sessions unaffected.

alisa: We're at +28m, error rate stable under 1% cluster-wide, legacy costs are ok. Planning to keep diversion for another 30m and then do a canary traffic return for /v2/infer/model-x. Anyone object?

maria: No objections. Recommend running a small canary (5%) then 25% then full. Also verify tokenization regression tests before full return.

oncall: I'll coordinate the canary and watch for regression alerts.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: auto-rollback timer cancelled by user=alisa rule=gatekeeper-2012345678

alisA: (typo) meant alisa: Thanks all — moving to canary plan now.

nate: After canary completes, let's add a console guard to prevent accidental simultaneous rollouts to eu clusters until the UI bug is fixed. Filed ENGPLAT-702.

maria: Can we add a small runtime guard that rejects console rollouts if clusters match eu-* until the bug is fixed? I can take that.

alisa: Great. Closing this thread once canary finished and console guard PR is merged. :white_check_mark:
